# partiteai_skill (Data Source)

Skill data source. Look up a skill by `id` or by `name` (exactly one must be set).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Skill identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) The skill's own name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `declared_name` (String) The name `SKILL.md` declares, which the agent knows the skill by
- `description` (String) The description `SKILL.md` declares
- `files` (Map of String) The files of the skill folder, by path, `SKILL.md` among them
- `instructions` (String) The body of `SKILL.md`, after its front matter
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
